author: packs
description: Procurement (W3-T1): purchase requisitions with lines, purchase orders to a vendor with lines, goods receipts against an order, and vendor bills, each numbered within its series, with their lifecycles, roles and an open-orders report. Needs the vendor-supplier pack.
name: procurement

definition.description: Approves requisitions and issues purchase orders.
definition.name: Buyer
Procurement: Open Purchase Orders
definition.sql: SELECT id, number, vendor_ref, order_date, expected_date, grand_total, status FROM purchase_order WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND status IN ('issued', 'partly_received') ORDER BY expected_date

definition.name: Procurement: Bills Due
definition.sql: SELECT id, number, vendor_ref, due_date, grand_total, match_status FROM vendor_bill WHERE is_active IS NOT FALSE AND status = 'posted' ORDER BY due_date

title: Pack: procurement
